snippet.title: Welcome to Hattrick
snippet.description:
Play Hattrick – the classic online football manager game where you face real opponents from 150+ countries. No pay to win!

Imagine a football manager game where you’re not just up against a computer algorithm—you’re facing real people from over 150 countries around the globe!

In Hattrick, every decision counts. With just two matches per week, it’s a game built to fit your life, instead of taking it over. There is plenty of time to explore and socialize in between matches. Whether you want to dive deep into tactics, train and scout young talent, manage transfers, or just enjoy the thrill of outsmarting your rivals—the game moves at your pace.

No pay-to-win. No resets. Ever. Your legacy, your club, and your strategy grow over time. For 25 years, over 200,000 active managers have built a one-of-a-kind football community unlike any other.

Start your journey as a football manager today. Join Hattrick and experience the beautiful game like never before!

Play now for free:
🌐 www.hattrick.org
📱 App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hattrick-football-manager-game/id483569714
📱 Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.hattrick.hattrick

🔗 Follow us on social media:
📸 Instagram: @hattrickfootballmanager
📘 Facebook: facebook.com/hattrick
🐦 Twitter / X: @hattrick
